headlineVerdict: Walking pad (under-desk treadmill), Amazon US: the top 100 listings move 150,225 units and $19.5M a month, and 46.2% of category sales come from listings under 300 reviews, but at the $99.99 median price one unit leaves only $15.16 before advertising — an 18.3% gross margin. Verdict: stop for a seller buying traffic. A seller with their own factory could still enter, but only with a different product definition.
